status: Retrospective protocol recorded before computing these transfer fits; earlier aggregate intervention counts are already known
primary_target: Native-1-ms common observed threshold flag response under controlled-shock run 833, using no shock qubit outcomes for fitting
matching: Each PT qubit record has its own same-number acceleration and trigger record; shock acceleration is separate run 832, used only as the notebook's repeated-forcing reference for run 833
observation: Positive saved first PCA quadrature; identical G/E calibration centering and positive normalization make this the previously defined u>0.5 flag, not a known intrinsic excited-state indicator

forcing.law: causal lowpass of acceleration, squared, then causal exponential reservoir; transition uses reservoir at preceding qubit sample

models.linear: independent two-state continuous-time chains conditional on forcing, u_q=b_q+k_q*E, d_q constant; exact 1 ms transition; one shared reservoir time chosen by training likelihood
models.saturated_extension: same fitted parameters, but E is capped at the maximum over all PT control inputs; exactly the same transition laws on all retained PT records

parameters: Positive b_q,k_q,d_q; bounded numerical search, four deterministic rate initializations per grid time; optimizer success and boundary contact reported; no global optimum claim
targets: exposure-normalized flag rates in six protocol-phase intervals [0,.05,.1,.2,.4,.8,1.5] s
cross-qubit observed onset pairs at lags -10 through +10 ms
consecutive flagged runs of 1,2,3-5,6+ samples, with boundary censoring explicit
prediction: Unconditional forward propagation from each acquisition's measured initial flag pair; no later target qubit histories are supplied. Conditional transition likelihood is reported separately for validation diagnostics.
uncertainty: Per-acquisition results and explicit forcing/support limitations; no IID-shot confidence claim, no certified physical-model adequacy, no controller ranking
success_gate: A fit must describe calibration validation and transfer structure before any physical interpretation; identical calibration laws alone do not make countermodels empirically adequate
subsequent_diagnostic: After initial transfer failure, audit found different accelerometer DC offsets. Repeat the entire fixed calibration/transfer procedure after subtracting each forcing record pre-trigger mean. This baseline is available before qubit acquisition. Preserve both outputs; do not label the diagnostic prespecified.
